name: Da Bai Fen
summary: A four-player partnership point-trick game where declarers set trumps and try to prevent opponents from taking 40+ card-points.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships (facing) use 54 cards including two jokers. Point cards are K=10, 10=10, 5=5 for 100 total. Each side has a level 2-Ace; declarers' level is the trump rank. 18 trumps: both jokers (red high), all cards of trump rank, and all cards of trump suit. During the deal 12 cards each are drawn one by one from a central packet; any player holding the trump rank may expose it face up to make its suit trumps. If none exposed, the top of the 6-card kitty determines trumps. Leader takes kitty and discards 6 face down. Void-trump hand may claim a redeal. Play is anticlockwise. Single or multiple cards of one suit may be led, but a multiple lead is only legal if no remaining card of that suit in any hand beats any led card. Follow suit with same number of cards if able; else discard anything. Highest trump wins, or highest of led suit if no trump. Earliest of equal trumps wins. Points in declarers' tricks vs opponents: points taken determine if declarers stay and score level-ups or opponents become new declarers and may score.
rating_reason: King-Ten-Five trick game with declarative play
